content.text:
I fixed the contact page. The long support email address (`[EMAIL]`) had no way to wrap, so it ran out of its box. On phones it also made the page wider than the screen, and on desktop it spilled out of the "Other ways to reach us" card.

I added `overflow-wrap: anywhere` for the `.info-list dd` entries in `site/css/pages.css`. The address now wraps inside the card, as in the approved screenshots.

The full Playwright suite passes (28 tests), including the contact page's desktop and phone screenshot comparisons that were failing before. I didn't commit the change.

I didn't check what changed yesterday. The repo has only one commit, so there was no history to compare.

STATUS: DONE
